subject: Advanced dashboards + retention: packaging concession request and next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Lin <jessica.lin@saasify.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Advanced dashboards + retention: packaging concession request and next steps

Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo and the deep dive into your dashboarding needs. To summarize the ask from SaaSify:

- Longer retention for traces (12 months for high-cardinality lines)
- Higher dashboard seat compression (more visual widgets per seat)
- A short-term buffer for surge ingestion while you onboard new customers

Attached: SaaSify_Month1_usage_snapshot.csv and our initial proposal_v1.pdf so you have the figures we used in the call.

What we can offer up-front (pending approvals):
- A one-time retention credit equal to ~100k GB-hrs for the first 30 days to cover migration spikes
- 20% off advanced dashboard seat pricing in year one if you commit to 12 months
- Waived overage fees for traces for the first 60 days (counts against the retention credit)

Can you confirm procurement timeline and whether DocuSign is the preferred contract path? If you prefer a PO / SOW flow, please share the contact (procurement@...) and timeline — we can route Legal accordingly.

Next step from our side: I'll loop Karthik and Marissa to get an approved concession template and formal quote.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments referenced: SaaSify_Month1_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV), proposal_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Jessica Lin <jessica.lin@saasify.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@saasify.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Advanced dashboards + retention: packaging concession request and next steps

Hi Neha —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the draft numbers. A couple clarifying questions before we escalate to procurement: 

1) The 100k GB-hrs retention credit — what does that map to in our current ingestion profile? (we're seeing bursts up to 12M events/day right now)
2) For the 20% dashboard seat discount: does that apply to add-on visualization packs (time-series + logs + charts) or only base seats?
3) Waived overage fees for traces: do you have a hard cap we should expect after the 60 days?

I've attached a short internal requirements doc (SaaSify_internal_requirements.docx) that lists the SLAs and export obligations our procurement team will require. Our procurement lead (procurement@saasify.com) prefers DocuSign, but they need a line-item breakdown and an explicit description of 'retention credits' to include on the PO.

If you can provide a consolidated line-item quote and an explicit example (e.g., how credits/how overages are consumed), we can move to PO next week.

Thanks,
Jessica Lin
Head of Product, SaaSify
jessica.lin@saasify.com

Attachment: SaaSify_internal_requirements.docx (DOCX)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Advanced dashboards + retention: packaging concession request and next steps

Neha / Marissa —

I've modeled three concession buckets in pricing_model_v2.xlsx (attached). High level recommendation:

- Base offer (no commit): keep standard pricing; provide 30k retention credits trial and no dashboard discount.
- Commit-12mo offer (preferred): 100k retention credits + 15% off advanced dashboard pack (time-series + logs + charts) in year one; include a 90-day surge buffer of up to 200k tokens ingress that won't count toward their committed unit usage (aimed at onboarding spikes).
- Enterprise-commit (3yr / >$500k ARR): 20% off dashboard pack + 250k retention credits + dedicated onboarding credits and an SLA uplift.

Practical notes: retention credits should be consumed in order by oldest retention buckets first (this is how the runtime applies credits now). For legal and procurement, we need the quote to show: credit quantity, definition of GB-hr, example consumption math, and the fallback pricing once credits are exhausted.

I'm inclined to approve the Commit-12mo offer as the counter to SaaSify given the product fit and our cost model, but I want Marissa to sign off on the surge buffer and the dashboard discount. If approved, we'll generate RDW_quote_SaaSify_v2.pdf and send via DocuSign (link below).

HubSpot: HPST-23847
DocuSign (draft envelope): https://docusign.com/rdw/abc123

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions Pricing, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_model_v2.xlsx (XLSX)

Hi Jessica / Neha —

Thanks for the diligence here. Approving the Commit-12mo counteroffer with the following explicit scope (so procurement can land the PO cleanly):

- 100k GB-hrs retention credits (defined in quote) valid for 12 months from contract effective date; consumed per our standard retention-first logic.
- 15% discount on Redwood Advanced Dashboard Pack for contract year 1 only (time-series + logs + charts bundles).
- Surge buffer: Up to 200k event tokens free for onboarding across first 90 days; any surge beyond that billed at standard overage rates.

Action items:
1) Neha — please send RDW_quote_SaaSify_v2.pdf to procurement@saasify.com and Jessica; include the line-item credit math and an example row that procurement can copy into their PO.
2) Neha / Legal — route the DocuSign envelope (link above) with SOW reference HPST-23847. Include the procurement contact on the envelope.
3) Jessica — please confirm procurement contact name and that DocuSign is acceptable. If they require a PO-first flow, we'll provide a signed quote that they can attach to the PO.

We'll mark this as Approved and move to signature once we have procurement details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
